linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin.goal: Build authority → drive DMs → book audit calls

hook_formulas: Contrarian: "[Conventional wisdom] is wrong. Here's what actually works:"
Data bomb: "I analyzed [number] [things]. Here's what [audience] needs to know:"
Myth buster: "[Number] myths I wish I'd stopped believing earlier:"
post_structure: One thought per line with aggressive line breaks
Specific numbers: $X, Y%, Z cases — never round numbers
End with specific question to drive comments
No external links in post body — add in first comment
carousel_rules: Slide 1: Bold hook that stops scroll
One insight per slide, clear visual hierarchy
Final slide: CTA (comment keyword, save, follow)
Consistent brand colors + fonts across all slides
meeting_conversion: Offer free 15-min audits in comment replies (not post body)
Use 'comment [keyword] and I'll send it' pattern
Post free tools/templates that showcase expertise
Reference the link in comments, not the post
75%+ comment reply rate — respond to every comment

x_single.name: X (Twitter) — Single Tweets
x_single.goal: Start conversations → build following → DM qualified prospects

worst_formats: external links in tweet body (kills reach)

hook_formulas: Contrarian: "You don't need [popular thing]. You need [better alternative]"
Bold claim: "[Bold statement]. Here's why: [numbered list]"
Before/after: "I went from [start] to [result] in [time]. Here's how:"
post_structure: Each sentence on its own line, parallel structure
Punchy — every word earns its place
One longer line for the punchline/payoff
Direct, no jargon, from lived experience
Provocative enough to get quote tweets and replies
meeting_conversion: Reply 'audit' and I'll DM you the template
Pin high-value thread with CTA in last tweet
Engage 10-20 replies to your own tweets (150x multiplier)
Mix public signals (likes/replies) before DMing prospects
Track: reply rate → positive reply rate → meetings booked → revenue

voices_to_study.name: Alex Hormozi
voices_to_study.why: 7K+ likes on top tweets. Direct, no jargon. Money/results focused. Juxtaposes rich vs poor archetypes.

voices_to_study.name: Ship30for30
voices_to_study.why: Thread hook mastery. 5 headline elements: clear, WHO, WHAT, WHY, twist the knife.

x_thread.name: X (Twitter) — Threads
x_thread.goal: Deep value delivery → thread goes viral → profile visits → DMs

hook_formulas: Specificity: "I [achieved result with exact numbers] in [timeframe]. Here's the [X]-step system:"
Question: "Why do [surprising observation]? The answer isn't what you think."
Bold claim: "[Controversial statement]. Here's the proof."
Curiosity gap: "I discovered [number] [tactics] that [result]. Most people don't know about #[number]."
thread_structure: Tweet 1: Hook with specific numbers + curiosity gap
Tweets 3-6: Core content (one insight per tweet, numbered)
Tweet 7: Engagement driver (question or action request)
Tweet 8: Clear CTA (reply keyword for DM, repost request)
meeting_conversion: Last tweet: 'Reply [keyword] and I'll DM you the full template'
Second-to-last: 'If useful, repost — a firm owner needs to see this'
Each tweet stands alone but builds narrative arc

youtube.name: YouTube
youtube.goal: Build trust through depth → funnel to landing page → book calls

key_signals: CTR from thumbnails determines initial distribution
session watch time rewards longer content
algorithm.video_length: 8-15 minutes for main content, under 60s for Shorts

script_structure: Hook (0-30s): Open with surprising data or bold claim
Problem (30s-2min): Agitate the pain — make them feel it
Proof (10-12min): Case study or results demonstration
CTA (last 30s): Direct to free resource in description
content_rules.mid_roll_cta: Before step 3: 'If this is your firm — free audit link in description. No pitch, just data.'
content_rules.end_screen_cta: Direct to specific next video + audit booking link
description_strategy: First 2 lines: CTA + link BEFORE 'Show more' cutoff
Pinned comment: Repeat CTA with direct link
Reference lead magnet verbally at start AND end of video
UTM parameters on all links for tracking
meeting_conversion: Mention free audit 2x per video (mid-roll + end)
Description link to Calendly/booking page
Pinned comment with booking link
Use YouTube Cards at mid-roll CTA moment
Mix Shorts (discovery) → long-form (trust) → booking (conversion)

blog.name: Blog / SEO
blog.goal: Rank for high-intent keywords → capture leads → nurture to call

structure: 1500-2500 words, every section earns the next
Bottom CTA: full audit offer with link
seo_focus: Target 'law firm marketing' + practice area + location variations
Featured snippet optimization with direct answers in first paragraph
meeting_conversion: Inline CTA: 'Want to know your exact cost per signed case? Free 15-min audit →'
Bottom CTA: 2-3 next steps including audit booking
Sidebar/sticky: calculator or scorecard lead magnet
Exit intent: free resource popup

newsletter.name: Newsletter / Email
newsletter.goal: Nurture subscribers → build trust weekly → convert to calls

structure: Subject line: specific number or contrarian take
Opening: one specific insight or story
Close: soft CTA (reply, forward, or book)
meeting_conversion: Soft close: 'Hit reply if you have questions — I read every email'
Forward hook: 'Know a firm owner who needs this? Forward this email'
Occasional direct offer: 'I have 3 audit slots open this week'
